name: SAHRA / NHRA Heritage Permits
description: South African Heritage Resources Agency (SAHRA) permit workflow under the National Heritage Resources Act, 1999 (Act 25 of 1999). Researcher applies, supervising professor endorses, then the application is submitted to SAHRA and the outcome recorded. Covers s.35 archaeology/palaeontology/meteorites, s.32 heritage object export, s.34 structures and s.36 burial grounds & graves.
author: The Archive and Heritage Group
